Dialogue_Text: "The group walked the silver sands of this unusual place. It felt like walking the moon, or a similar place, but—what if that is truly the moon? Or some celestial plane? None of them remember how they got there. They feel they were supposed to be there, but... why?"

"It was then that three winged women walked out of the white fog. They must have been sisters; their faces shared some features, and they all had similar hair. Each of them was holding a different weapon."
This place sounds magical... but are those women there to kill the heroes?
Ah, you are considering facing the sisters. If you decide that you want to visit that unusual place and look them in the eyes and fight them, let me know. The cost is 3,500 gold pieces.
Right. I want to face them. I'll pay.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Of course. And remember: don't let them kill you.
